title: La redova de San Félix, pasos básicos, tutorial

observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

extraction.teacher_style: The instructor demonstrates basic steps with a partner while explaining counts and footwork verbally to seated students. He breaks down each basic step sequentially before performing them with music.

lesson_structure.note: Teacher introduces the basic steps of La Redova de San Félix with a partner.
Teacher demonstrates the first step (paso basico de pasito).
Teacher demonstrates the second step (basico de la redova).
Teacher demonstrates step with hands in prioma.
Teacher demonstrates step metiendo la cadera.
Teacher demonstrates step starting with left foot and media vuelta.
Teacher demonstrates la vuelta with three steps and foot contact.
Demonstration of all steps combined with live music accompaniment.

steps_taught.name: paso basico de pasito
steps_taught.description: Basic walking step with alternating feet.

what_works: Step-by-step sequential breakdown of each variation
Clear verbal counting synchronized with footwork
what_hinders: Students are seated watching rather than following along interactively

quotes.text: Vamos a mirar los pasos de la redova que son cinco.
El segundo paso es el básico de la redova.
Ahora lo vamos a hacer con música.

evidence_segments.observation: Teacher and partner demonstrate footwork holding hands while counting aloud.
evidence_segments.cannot_infer: exact weight distribution on foot strikes

evidence_segments.observation: Partners step side to side keeping upper body upright.
evidence_segments.cannot_infer: exact foot placement details due to distance

extraction.distinctive_method: Structuring the lesson into discrete numbered basic steps demonstrated with a partner before a final musical walkthrough.
